title: catalogue: single pathway
description: catalogue/pathways/<pathway>.json holds one pathway's tiers (CAT-1 AMENDMENT, Prompt 140 Unit 1): tier id, display name and focus (TN-1), course slug, status, contexts built, what the tier assumes from the one before, and its voice band. Teaching prose stays in docs/curriculum/pathway-tier-mapping.md; each tier entry points at it, no prose is copied in.

pathwayId.description: Matches this pathway's id in catalogue/pathways.json.

displayName.description: TN-1: capitalised display name. 'Beginner' retired as a tier name.

focus.description: This tier's focus per its header line in the mapping doc (e.g. 'Starting').

courseSlug.description: PK-1 course slug (<pathway-slug>-<tier>), where a course exists. null where no course has been built or scaffolded for this tier.

status.description: Not a literally sourced vocabulary; constructed for this catalogue (see report). 'in-design' for referencing-introductory per the ruling. 'built' means a course folder under courses/ that has been built, and nothing else; a folder under archive/ never counts (RBD-1 AMENDMENT). 'planned' otherwise, the ruling's stated default.

contextsBuilt.description: Context-pack ids under content/context-packs/ that have a subfolder for this tier's courseSlug. null where courseSlug is null.

assumesFromPrevious.description: What this tier assumes from the one before. No source states this per-tier (the mapping doc's Progression logic lines are whole-pathway, not per-tier); recorded null throughout (see report).

voiceBand.description: doc/ref citation to this pathway's Voice-band anchor line in the mapping doc. note carries the tier-specific band descriptor quoted from that line.

teachingProsePointer.description: doc/ref citation to this tier's own section in docs/curriculum/pathway-tier-mapping.md. No teaching prose is copied into the catalogue.
